statement:
The airspace record for sector 7 lists the status as open with ban hours from 12:00 to 23:00.
The airspace record for sector 7 indicates an active flight ban today from 12:00 to 23:00. In accordance with safety and airspace restrictions, flight job SV-19 over sector 7 has been placed on hold.
judge_text:
WRONG
It asserts "an active flight ban today from 12:00 to 23:00" and places SV-19 on hold, contradicting the record's "open" status.
